algorithm: Largest-remainder per-stratum image quotas; seeded group order; subset-sum allocation test then validation then train
allocation: 70/15/15, stratified by volume class x background x folder magnification
challenge_tests: Report final subgroups by background/magnification; separate condition-transfer experiments are secondary and cannot tune on main test images
early_stopping: Validation may select epoch count; fix that count before train+validation refit
final_fit: Lock recipe and training schedule, then optionally refit on train+validation (466 images), score once on test (82 images)
group_rule: User-confirmed individual preparations; merge confirmed same-scene views; legacy class-wide groups are historical only
holdout_access: All images audited in Phase 1; after this freeze use training for processing design and validation for selection; test reserved for final scoring
leakage_rules: Design crops/masks using training images; fit scalers/PCA/selectors and other learned transforms on train only during selection
Split before augmentation or tiling; descendants inherit source preparation and partition; one image-level prediction
No EXIF, camera dates, filenames, paths or condition tags as visual classifier inputs
Exclude visible camera marks/borders only using reviewed, reproducible processing
Do not fit calibration on test; softmax is not a verified confidence estimate
magnification_conflicts: Retain four flagged images by source folder for stratification; omit only from trusted-magnification summaries
metric_definitions: poppypurev2.evaluation.classification_metrics; fixed seven-label order; binary prediction 0 versus >0
model_selection: Fit on train only; select processing/model on validation; no test scoring or visual model-error review before final recipe lock
post_evaluation_refit: Optional separate deployment version fits unchanged recipe on all 548 images; preserve evaluated model and its test predictions
tie_break: Within 0.005 validation macro F1 prefer fewer fitted parameters, then shorter measured training time
